blocks.text: iOS 18 broadened personalization and communication on iPhone. It let people place and recolor Home Screen controls more freely, reorganize Control Center, work with a redesigned Photos library, and use expanded Messages tools including text formatting, scheduled messages, RCS, and satellite messaging where supported.

citations.locator: iOS 18 — Home Screen, Control Center, Photos, and Messages

blocks.text: Safari, Passwords, and Maps also received substantial additions, while Apple’s separate security bulletin documented the release’s security corrections. Individual capabilities depend on compatible hardware, carrier service, language, and region.

citations.locator: iOS 18 — Safari, Passwords, Maps, and availability notes

blocks.text: iPadOS 18 paired wider Home Screen and Control Center customization with iPad-specific creative and productivity work. Calculator arrived on iPad with Math Notes, and handwriting tools in Notes could refine Smart Script while preserving a person’s writing style.

citations.locator: iPadOS 18 — Calculator, Math Notes, Handwriting, Home Screen, and Control Center

blocks.text: The release also revised navigation patterns inside apps, introduced the Passwords app, expanded privacy controls for apps and contacts, and added richer route planning in Maps. Apple documented security corrections separately from the consumer feature list.

citations.locator: iPadOS 18 — Apps, Passwords, Privacy, and Maps

blocks.text: iOS 18.0.1 was a focused corrective release. Apple identified touch-input and camera-recording problems on the iPhone 16 family, a Messages crash involving shared Apple Watch faces, and a memory-allocation issue that could affect performance.

Its security record also addressed premature audio capture before the microphone indicator on iPhone 16 models and a VoiceOver path that could expose saved passwords. These are release-specific fixes, not a restatement of the cumulative iOS 18 feature set.

iOS 18.1 delivered the first public Apple Intelligence feature set on supported iPhones. Writing Tools, a revised Siri experience, notification summaries, Reduce Interruptions, and new Photos search and cleanup tools brought assistance into communication, focus, and media workflows.

The release also added call recording and transcription, expanded Camera Control, and enabled AirPods Pro 2 hearing features in supported regions. Apple Intelligence and health capabilities have device, language, and geographic requirements, so their inclusion does not imply universal availability.

citations.locator: iOS 18.1 — Phone, Camera, AirPods, and availability notes

blocks.text: iPadOS 18.1 introduced Apple Intelligence on supported M-series iPads. Its first wave combined systemwide Writing Tools and Siri changes with notification summaries, Reduce Interruptions, smart replies, Photos cleanup, natural-language search, and generated memory movies.

Notes could summarize transcribed audio, AirPods Pro 2 gained hearing features in supported regions, and Control Center connectivity controls became easier to configure. Hardware, language, and region restrictions remain material to the release record.

citations.locator: iPadOS 18.1 — Notes, AirPods, Control Center, and availability notes

blocks.text: iOS 18.1.1 was a security-only maintenance release in Apple’s consumer notes. Its bulletin documented fixes in JavaScriptCore and WebKit for malicious web content that could lead to code execution or cross-site scripting.

Apple’s exploitation notice for both vulnerabilities specifically referred to Intel-based Mac systems. This archive therefore does not characterize the notice as evidence that the flaws were actively exploited on iPhone.

iOS 18.2 expanded Apple Intelligence with Image Playground, Genmoji, Image Wand, and optional ChatGPT access through Siri and Writing Tools. On the iPhone 16 family, Visual Intelligence and a two-stage Camera Control shutter added camera-centered recognition and capture workflows.

citations.locator: iOS 18.2 — Apple Intelligence and Camera Control

blocks.text: Mail categories, Safari privacy and transfer tools, Photos navigation changes, layered Voice Memos on supported models, and Find My item-location sharing widened the update beyond AI. Availability varies by hardware, language, region, carrier, and service partner.

citations.locator: iOS 18.2 — Mail, Safari, Photos, Voice Memos, and Find My

blocks.text: iPadOS 18.2 broadened the Apple Intelligence toolset on supported iPads with Image Playground, Genmoji, Image Wand, more flexible Writing Tools, and optional ChatGPT access from Siri and Writing Tools.

The release also added Safari’s HTTPS preference and download progress, Find My item-location sharing, natural-language search in Music and TV, Podcast discovery changes, and targeted Photos reliability work. Apple Intelligence capabilities remain limited by device, language, and region.

citations.locator: iPadOS 18.2 — Safari, Find My, media apps, and Photos

blocks.text: iOS 18.2.1 was a narrow maintenance release. Apple described it only as providing important bug fixes and recommended it for all users; the public note did not identify the affected components or observable symptoms.

Because Apple published no itemized fix list or dedicated security bulletin for this version, this record intentionally preserves that uncertainty rather than assigning fixes reported for other iOS 18 releases.

iOS 18.3 extended Visual Intelligence on iPhone 16 models with calendar-event extraction and plant or animal identification. It also made notification summaries easier to manage and visually distinguish, while temporarily disabling summaries for News and Entertainment apps.

citations.locator: iOS 18.3 — Visual Intelligence and notification summaries

blocks.text: Smaller corrections covered repeated Calculator operations, the keyboard during typed Siri requests, and Apple Music audio that could continue after the app was closed. The release also carried a separate set of documented security fixes.

iPadOS 18.3 refined notification summaries on Apple Intelligence-capable iPads. Users could manage the feature from the Lock Screen, summaries gained clearer visual treatment, and News and Entertainment summaries were temporarily unavailable.

The update also restored the keyboard in affected typed Siri requests and made Calculator repeat the last operation when the equals button is tapped again. Apple’s security bulletin documents the broader maintenance work separately.

iOS 18.3.1 was a targeted security update. Apple fixed an authorization weakness that could let a physical attack disable USB Restricted Mode on a locked device and said the issue may have been used in a highly targeted, sophisticated attack.

Apple later added a Messages entry for malicious photos or videos shared through an iCloud Link, with the same targeted-exploitation warning. The June addition is recorded as a later bulletin update, not as proof that the item appeared in the original February notice.
iOS 18.3.2 corrected a problem that could prevent some streaming content from playing. Apple otherwise characterized the update as providing important bug fixes and security updates.

The security bulletin identifies a supplementary WebKit sandbox-escape fix. Apple’s exploitation qualification applies to versions before iOS 17.2, so this record does not imply that the cited attack was occurring against iOS 18.3.2.

iOS 18.4 expanded Apple Intelligence with Priority Notifications, a Sketch style in Image Playground, and more supported languages and English locales. It also added the Apple Vision Pro companion app for owners of the headset.

citations.locator: iOS 18.4 — Apple Intelligence and Apple Vision Pro app

blocks.text: Apple News+ gained recipes and guided cooking, Photos gained organization and filtering controls, and the wider system added emoji, Safari search suggestions, child-account safeguards, persistent Screen Time limits, App Store review summaries, Ambient Music, and Matter robot-vacuum support.

citations.locator: iOS 18.4 — News+, Photos, and additional enhancements

blocks.text: iPadOS 18.4 added Priority Notifications, a Sketch style in Image Playground, and more Apple Intelligence languages and locales on supported iPads. Mail categorization also arrived on iPad, grouping messages into Primary, Transactions, Updates, and Promotions.

The release paired Apple News+ recipes and cooking mode with Photos organization controls, new emoji, Safari search suggestions, child-account protections, persistent Screen Time limits, App Store review summaries, Ambient Music, and Matter robot-vacuum support.

citations.locator: iPadOS 18.4 — News+, Photos, and additional enhancements

blocks.text: iOS 18.4.1 fixed a rare problem that could prevent wireless CarPlay from connecting in certain vehicles. Apple otherwise described it as an important bug-fix and security update.
The security bulletin documented CoreAudio and Pointer Authentication corrections and said both issues may have been exploited in extremely sophisticated attacks against specific targeted iOS users.

citations.locator: CoreAudio and RPAC; CVE-2025-31200 and CVE-2025-31201

blocks.text: iOS 18.5 added the Pride Harmony Lock Screen wallpaper and gave parents a notification when a Screen Time passcode is used on a child’s device. Buy with iPhone could authorize Apple TV app purchases on a third-party device.

The update fixed a black-screen problem in the Apple Vision Pro app and enabled carrier-provided satellite features on the iPhone 13 family where carriers support them. A separate Apple bulletin records the version’s security work.

citations.locator: iOS 18.5 — Apple Vision Pro app and carrier satellite support

blocks.text: iPadOS 18.5 was a modest feature and maintenance update. It added a Pride Harmony wallpaper and notified parents when a Screen Time passcode was used on a child’s device.

Buy with iPad could authorize Apple TV app purchases made on a third-party device. Apple also documented bug fixes and a separate body of security corrections without attributing iPhone-only additions to iPad.

iOS 18.6 was primarily a maintenance release. Its only itemized consumer fix addressed a Photos problem that could prevent memory movies from being shared, while Apple’s security bulletin documented a broader set of corrections.

Developer notes also recorded a HealthKit known issue on devices without a passcode: health data could become unavailable at the slide-to-power-off screen. It is preserved here as a known issue, not misrepresented as a fix delivered by 18.6.

iPadOS 18.6 was primarily a maintenance release. Apple itemized a Photos fix for memory movies that could not be shared and published a separate security bulletin covering privacy, accessibility, media, networking, and other components.

The developer notes also documented a HealthKit known issue on devices without a passcode at the slide-to-power-off screen. This record treats that item as an outstanding limitation rather than a resolved change.
iOS 18.7 continued the iOS 18 maintenance branch as iOS 26 launched. Apple’s consumer note promised important bug fixes and security updates but did not enumerate user-facing fixes.

The dedicated security record supplies the concrete detail: it documents corrections across media parsing, privacy, the kernel, Notes, Shortcuts, WebKit, and other components. This article highlights representative items without implying that the short list is exhaustive.

events.summary: The public iOS 18 release established the cycle’s personalization, Photos, Messages, Safari, Passwords, and Maps foundations, alongside a separately documented security update.

changes.title: Home Screen and Control Center customization
changes.canonicalSummary: iPhone gained freer Home Screen placement and appearance controls plus a reorganizable, multi-group Control Center.
changes.summary: Apps and widgets could be arranged with more open space, icons could use dark or tinted appearances, and Control Center controls could be grouped, resized, and reached from additional pages.

citations.locator: iOS 18 — Home Screen and Control Center

changes.title: Redesigned Photos library
changes.canonicalSummary: Photos adopted a unified library view with automatically organized collections and configurable presentation.
changes.summary: The Photos redesign combined the grid and collections into a single view, added topic-based organization, and let users reorder or pin the collections they use most.

changes.title: Messages formatting, effects, and Send Later
changes.canonicalSummary: Messages added richer text expression, expanded reactions, and scheduling for messages sent through iMessage.
changes.summary: Bold, underline, italic, and strikethrough formatting joined animated text effects, broader Tapbacks, and Send Later for composing messages ahead of time.

changes.title: RCS and Messages via satellite
changes.canonicalSummary: Messages expanded off-network and cross-platform communication through satellite messaging and carrier-supported RCS.
changes.summary: Supported devices could send messages over satellite when cellular and Wi-Fi service were unavailable, while carrier-supported RCS improved media, receipts, and group messaging with non-Apple devices.

citations.locator: iOS 18 — Messages via satellite and RCS messaging

changes.title: Safari Highlights, Reader, and Distraction Control
changes.canonicalSummary: Safari added page summaries and contextual highlights, a revised Reader, and tools for hiding distracting page elements.
changes.summary: Supported pages could surface summaries and useful details through Highlights and Reader, while Distraction Control let users hide selected page elements that interfered with browsing.

changes.title: Passwords app
changes.canonicalSummary: A dedicated Passwords app brought credentials, passkeys, verification codes, Wi-Fi passwords, and security alerts into one place.
changes.summary: Passwords moved credential management into a standalone app with synced access to passwords, passkeys, verification codes, Wi-Fi credentials, and warnings about weak or compromised passwords.

events.summary: The public iPadOS 18 release combined iPad-first Calculator and handwriting work with broader customization, navigation, privacy, and credential-management changes.

changes.title: Calculator and Math Notes
changes.canonicalSummary: Calculator arrived on iPad with Math Notes for evaluating handwritten or typed expressions in a notebook-style workspace.
changes.summary: The first iPad Calculator included basic and scientific modes plus Math Notes, where expressions, variables, graphs, and results could be developed with Apple Pencil or a keyboard.

changes.title: Smart Script handwriting refinement
changes.canonicalSummary: Notes could smooth and edit handwriting while retaining the writer’s general personal style.
changes.summary: Smart Script refined handwritten text in real time and supported editing operations such as inserting typed text, pasting handwriting, and reflowing a paragraph.

changes.title: Home Screen and Control Center customization
changes.canonicalSummary: iPad gained freer icon placement and appearance settings plus a more configurable Control Center.
changes.summary: Users could place icons and widgets with more open space, tint or darken icons, and reorganize or resize controls across Control Center groups.

citations.locator: iPadOS 18 — Home Screen and Control Center

changes.title: Revised in-app navigation
changes.canonicalSummary: A floating tab bar, adaptable sidebars, a revised document browser, and new animations changed navigation in supported iPad apps.
changes.summary: Supported apps gained a floating tab bar that could become a sidebar, alongside document-browser and animation refinements intended to make deeper app hierarchies easier to navigate.

changes.title: Locked apps and narrower data access
changes.canonicalSummary: App locking and hiding joined controls that narrowed which contacts and Bluetooth accessories an app could access.
changes.summary: Users could require authentication to open an app, hide selected apps, share only chosen contacts, and more deliberately authorize Bluetooth accessory access.

changes.title: Passwords app
changes.canonicalSummary: A dedicated Passwords app centralized credentials, passkeys, verification codes, Wi-Fi passwords, and security alerts.
changes.summary: Passwords brought synced passwords, passkeys, verification codes, Wi-Fi credentials, and warnings about weak or compromised credentials into one app.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.0.1 release concentrated on early iPhone 16 reliability issues and two security corrections involving microphone indication and VoiceOver password disclosure.

changes.title: iPhone 16 touch-response fix
changes.canonicalSummary: A touch-input reliability correction addressed temporary failures to respond on iPhone 16 models.
changes.summary: The update fixed a condition in which the screen could temporarily stop responding to touch on iPhone 16 and iPhone 16 Pro models.

changes.title: iPhone 16 Pro macro-recording fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Camera reliability improved for macro-mode video recording on iPhone 16 Pro models.
changes.summary: The camera no longer froze in the documented case when recording macro-mode 4K video with HDR turned off on iPhone 16 Pro and iPhone 16 Pro Max.

changes.title: Shared Watch face reply crash fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Messages no longer crashed in the documented reply flow for a shared Apple Watch face.
changes.summary: Apple corrected a Messages crash that could occur when replying to a message containing a shared Apple Watch face.

changes.title: Memory-allocation performance fix
changes.canonicalSummary: A memory-allocation issue that could affect performance on some iPhone models was corrected.
changes.summary: The release addressed a memory-allocation problem that Apple said could affect performance on some iPhone models.

changes.title: Audio-message microphone indicator fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Audio messages could no longer capture initial audio before the microphone privacy indicator appeared.
changes.summary: On iPhone 16 models, Apple fixed a path in which Messages audio recording could capture a few seconds before the microphone indicator activated.

changes.title: VoiceOver password-disclosure fix
changes.canonicalSummary: VoiceOver validation was strengthened so saved passwords would not be read aloud through the documented path.
changes.summary: The update addressed a logic issue that could cause VoiceOver to speak a user’s saved passwords aloud.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.1 release introduced the first Apple Intelligence capabilities on supported iPhones and added call recording, Camera Control, and AirPods hearing features.

changes.title: Writing Tools and revised Siri
changes.canonicalSummary: Systemwide writing assistance and a redesigned Siri experience formed the first public Apple Intelligence release.
changes.summary: Supported iPhones gained proofreading, rewriting, summarization, a revised Siri interface, more resilient request handling, and Type to Siri.

changes.title: Photos search, Clean Up, and memory movies
changes.canonicalSummary: Photos gained natural-language retrieval, object removal, and prompted memory-movie creation on supported iPhones.
changes.summary: Apple Intelligence added natural-language photo and video search, Clean Up for removing distractions, and memory movies generated from a description.

changes.title: Notification summaries and Reduce Interruptions
changes.canonicalSummary: Supported iPhones could summarize notifications and use an intelligent Focus mode to surface likely urgent items.
changes.summary: Apple Intelligence provided notification summaries and a Reduce Interruptions Focus that attempted to pass through notifications needing immediate attention.

changes.title: Priority Mail and smart replies
changes.canonicalSummary: Mail and Messages gained message prioritization, summaries, and suggested responses through Apple Intelligence.
changes.summary: Mail could elevate time-sensitive messages and summarize threads, while Mail and Messages offered context-aware smart replies on supported devices.

changes.title: Call recording and transcription
changes.canonicalSummary: Phone calls and FaceTime audio calls could be recorded with participant notice and transcribed in Notes.
changes.summary: The Phone app gained recording for calls and FaceTime audio calls, announced recording to participants, and stored audio and transcripts in Notes where supported.

changes.title: AirPods Pro 2 hearing health features
changes.canonicalSummary: AirPods Pro 2 added clinical-style hearing assessment and assistance features in supported countries and regions.
changes.summary: The update introduced Hearing Test, Hearing Aid, and Hearing Protection capabilities for AirPods Pro 2, subject to model, firmware, age, and regional availability requirements.

events.summary: The public iPadOS 18.1 release brought the first Apple Intelligence tools to supported M-series iPads and expanded Notes, AirPods, and Control Center behavior.

changes.title: Writing Tools and revised Siri
changes.canonicalSummary: Systemwide writing assistance and a redesigned Siri experience formed the first public Apple Intelligence release on iPad.
changes.summary: Supported M-series iPads gained proofreading, rewriting, summarization, a revised Siri interface, more resilient request handling, and Type to Siri.

changes.title: Photos search, Clean Up, and memory movies
changes.canonicalSummary: Photos gained natural-language retrieval, object removal, and prompted memory-movie creation on supported iPads.
changes.summary: Apple Intelligence added natural-language photo and video search, Clean Up for removing distractions, and memory movies generated from a description.

changes.title: Notification summaries and Reduce Interruptions
changes.canonicalSummary: Supported iPads could summarize notifications and use an intelligent Focus mode to surface likely urgent items.
changes.summary: Apple Intelligence provided notification summaries and a Reduce Interruptions Focus intended to pass through notifications needing immediate attention.

changes.title: Communication and Notes intelligence
changes.canonicalSummary: Mail, Messages, and Notes gained prioritization, summaries, smart replies, and transcription assistance on supported iPads.
changes.summary: Mail could prioritize and summarize messages, Mail and Messages offered smart replies, and Notes could summarize transcribed audio recordings.

changes.title: AirPods Pro 2 hearing health features
changes.canonicalSummary: AirPods Pro 2 added hearing assessment and assistance features in supported countries and regions.
changes.summary: The update introduced Hearing Test, Hearing Aid, and Hearing Protection capabilities for AirPods Pro 2, subject to model, firmware, age, and regional availability requirements.

changes.title: Individual connectivity controls
changes.canonicalSummary: Control Center offered separate controls for common connectivity functions and allowed additional arrangement.
changes.summary: Users could add individual controls for Wi-Fi, VPN, AirDrop, and Satellite where applicable, and adjust connectivity controls more directly.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.1.1 release fixed two web-content vulnerabilities; Apple’s active-exploitation qualification referred specifically to Intel-based Mac systems.

changes.title: JavaScriptCore code-execution fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Improved JavaScriptCore checks addressed a path from malicious web content to arbitrary code execution.
changes.summary: Apple corrected JavaScriptCore handling of malicious web content that could lead to arbitrary code execution; its exploitation notice named Intel-based Mac systems.

changes.title: WebKit cross-site scripting fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Improved cookie state management addressed a WebKit cross-site scripting vulnerability.
changes.summary: Apple fixed a cookie-management issue through which malicious web content could produce cross-site scripting; its exploitation notice named Intel-based Mac systems.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.2 release expanded Apple Intelligence into image generation and optional ChatGPT access while adding Camera Control, Mail, Safari, Find My, and media improvements.

changes.title: Image Playground and Genmoji
changes.canonicalSummary: Supported iPhones gained built-in tools for creating stylized images and custom emoji from prompts and people.
changes.summary: Image Playground generated animation or illustration-style images, while Genmoji created custom emoji from descriptions and could use people from the photo library.

changes.title: ChatGPT integration in Siri and Writing Tools
changes.canonicalSummary: Siri and Writing Tools could optionally hand suitable requests to ChatGPT with user-facing controls.
changes.summary: Supported devices could use ChatGPT through Siri or Writing Tools, including composition from a prompt, without requiring a ChatGPT account; signed-in use followed the account’s data terms.

changes.title: Visual Intelligence and two-stage Camera Control
changes.canonicalSummary: iPhone 16 models gained camera-based visual lookup and a two-stage shutter for locking focus and exposure.
changes.summary: Visual Intelligence could identify or act on information viewed through Camera Control, and a light press could lock focus and exposure before capture on supported iPhone 16 models.

changes.title: Mail categories and digest view
changes.canonicalSummary: Mail automatically grouped messages into broad categories and bundled messages from the same sender.
changes.summary: Mail categorization organized messages for prioritization, while digest view combined messages from an individual sender into a single browsable bundle.

changes.title: Safari transfer, HTTPS, and download tools
changes.canonicalSummary: Safari gained browsing-data import and export, stronger HTTPS preference, and live download progress.
changes.summary: Users could import or export browsing data, Safari preferred HTTPS where possible, and file downloads could expose progress through a Live Activity.

changes.title: Find My Share Item Location
changes.canonicalSummary: Find My could securely share an accessory’s location with trusted third parties assisting with recovery.
changes.summary: Share Item Location generated a temporary, controlled way to share an AirTag or Find My network accessory location with trusted organizations such as participating airlines.

events.summary: The public iPadOS 18.2 release expanded Apple Intelligence creation and writing tools while adding Safari, Find My, media-search, Podcast, and Photos improvements.

changes.title: Image Playground and Genmoji
changes.canonicalSummary: Supported iPads gained built-in tools for creating stylized images and custom emoji from prompts and people.
changes.summary: Image Playground generated animation or illustration-style images, while Genmoji created custom emoji from descriptions and could use people from the photo library.

changes.title: ChatGPT integration in Siri and Writing Tools
changes.canonicalSummary: Siri and Writing Tools could optionally hand suitable requests to ChatGPT with user-facing controls.
changes.summary: Supported iPads could use ChatGPT through Siri or Writing Tools, including composition from a prompt, without requiring a ChatGPT account; signed-in use followed the account’s data terms.

changes.title: Image Wand and described rewrites
changes.canonicalSummary: Notes and Writing Tools gained prompt-directed image creation and more specific rewrite instructions.
changes.summary: Image Wand could turn sketches or nearby note content into images, and Writing Tools accepted a description of the transformation the user wanted.

citations.locator: iPadOS 18.2 — Image Wand and Writing Tools

changes.title: Safari HTTPS preference and download progress
changes.canonicalSummary: Safari strengthened its preference for encrypted connections and exposed file-download progress as a Live Activity.
changes.summary: HTTPS Priority upgraded URLs to HTTPS when possible, while file-download Live Activities made progress visible outside Safari.

changes.title: Find My Share Item Location
changes.canonicalSummary: Find My could securely share an accessory’s location with trusted third parties assisting with recovery.
changes.summary: Share Item Location generated a temporary, controlled way to share an AirTag or Find My network accessory location with trusted organizations such as participating airlines.

changes.title: Natural-language media search and Podcast discovery
changes.canonicalSummary: Music, TV, and Podcasts gained more descriptive search and discovery tools.
changes.summary: Natural-language search in Music and TV accepted descriptions combining categories, while Podcasts added favorite categories and a more personalized Search page.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.2.1 note reported important bug fixes without naming affected components; this record does not invent or import fixes from adjacent releases.

changes.title: Unspecified maintenance fixes
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple reported important bug fixes but did not publish an itemized component or symptom list for iOS 18.2.1.
changes.summary: The complete public note described important bug fixes and recommended the update, but did not identify what changed; the evidence therefore supports only this aggregate maintenance entry.
changes.verificationMethod: Checked the complete iOS 18.2.1 section of Apple’s cumulative iOS 18 update article; no component-level list or dedicated Apple security bulletin was found for this version.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.3 release advanced Visual Intelligence and notification summaries while correcting smaller Calculator, Siri, and Apple Music behaviors.

changes.title: Visual Intelligence calendar and nature recognition
changes.canonicalSummary: Visual Intelligence could turn poster details into Calendar events and identify plants or animals on iPhone 16 models.
changes.summary: Camera Control’s Visual Intelligence added event extraction from posters and flyers plus plant and animal identification on the supported iPhone 16 family.

changes.title: Notification summary controls and presentation
changes.canonicalSummary: Notification summaries became easier to manage from the Lock Screen and more visually distinct from original notification text.
changes.summary: Users could adjust summary settings from the Lock Screen, and summarized text used italic styling and a glyph; News and Entertainment summaries were temporarily unavailable.

changes.title: Calculator repeat operation
changes.canonicalSummary: Calculator could repeat the most recent mathematical operation when the equals control was pressed again.
changes.summary: Tapping equals repeatedly applied the last operation again, restoring a common calculator behavior.

changes.title: Typed Siri keyboard fix
changes.canonicalSummary: The keyboard remained available when starting an affected typed Siri request.
changes.summary: Apple fixed a condition in which the keyboard could disappear when a user initiated a typed request to Siri.

changes.title: Apple Music playback-stop fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Closing Apple Music stopped audio instead of allowing the current song to continue through its end.
changes.summary: The update resolved a case in which Apple Music audio could continue until the song ended even after the app was closed.

events.summary: The public iPadOS 18.3 release refined notification summaries and corrected Calculator and typed Siri behavior.

changes.title: Notification summary controls and presentation
changes.canonicalSummary: Notification summaries became easier to manage from the Lock Screen and more visually distinct from original notification text.
changes.summary: Users could adjust summary settings from the Lock Screen, and summarized text used italic styling and a glyph; News and Entertainment summaries were temporarily unavailable.

changes.title: Calculator repeat operation
changes.canonicalSummary: Calculator could repeat the most recent mathematical operation when the equals control was pressed again.
changes.summary: Tapping equals repeatedly applied the last operation again, restoring a common calculator behavior.

changes.title: Typed Siri keyboard fix
changes.canonicalSummary: The keyboard remained available when starting an affected typed Siri request.
changes.summary: Apple fixed a condition in which the keyboard could disappear when a user initiated a typed request to Siri.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.3.1 release addressed two vulnerabilities associated with sophisticated attacks against specific targeted individuals; one bulletin entry was added later.

changes.title: USB Restricted Mode bypass fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Improved authorization state management prevented the documented physical bypass of USB Restricted Mode on a locked device.
changes.summary: Apple corrected a physical-attack path that could disable USB Restricted Mode on a locked device and said it may have been used against specific targeted individuals.

changes.title: Messages iCloud Link processing fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Additional checks addressed malicious photo or video content delivered through a Messages iCloud Link.
changes.summary: A later addition to Apple’s bulletin documented a fix for processing a maliciously crafted photo or video shared via an iCloud Link and carried a targeted-exploitation warning.
changes.verificationMethod: Apple labels this item as an entry added June 11, 2025, after the original February release.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.3.2 release fixed affected streaming playback and supplied a supplementary WebKit sandbox-escape correction.

changes.title: Streaming playback fix
changes.canonicalSummary: A media reliability correction restored playback for some streaming content that could fail to start.
changes.summary: Apple fixed an issue that could prevent some streaming content from playing.

changes.title: WebKit sandbox-escape supplementary fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Improved WebKit checks supplied an additional barrier against a malicious web-content sandbox escape.
changes.summary: The security update addressed an out-of-bounds write that could let malicious web content escape its sandbox; Apple described it as supplementary to an attack blocked in iOS 17.2.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.4 release expanded Apple Intelligence and added Apple Vision Pro, News+, Photos, emoji, family, App Store, media, and smart-home capabilities.

changes.title: Priority Notifications
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple Intelligence could place notifications it judged immediately important above the rest of the notification list.
changes.summary: Priority Notifications highlighted time-sensitive or important notifications at the top of the list on supported Apple Intelligence-capable iPhones.

changes.title: Image Playground Sketch and wider language support
changes.canonicalSummary: Image Playground gained a Sketch style while Apple Intelligence expanded to additional languages and English locales.
changes.summary: The release added Sketch as an Image Playground style and expanded Apple Intelligence support across eight more languages and two additional English locales.

changes.title: Apple Vision Pro companion app
changes.canonicalSummary: A companion app helped Apple Vision Pro owners find spatial content and access information about their headset.
changes.summary: The new Apple Vision Pro app surfaced content and spatial experiences and provided headset information for users paired with an Apple Vision Pro.

changes.title: Apple News+ Food and cooking mode
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple News+ added a recipe catalog, saved recipes, and a step-by-step cooking presentation.
changes.summary: News+ subscribers gained recipes from participating publishers, searchable and saved recipe collections, and a cooking mode for following individual steps.

changes.title: Photos library organization controls
changes.canonicalSummary: Photos gained more filters, sorting, collection-order controls, and privacy-aware import behavior.
changes.summary: The release added library filters, collection reordering, oldest-or-newest sorting, album sorting by modified date, controls for recent-history collections, and hidden-photo import protection.

changes.title: System, family, store, and Home additions
changes.canonicalSummary: A broad set of smaller additions covered emoji, Safari, child accounts, Screen Time, App Store, media widgets, languages, and Matter accessories.
changes.summary: Eight emoji, Safari recent searches, safer child setup, persistent app limits, App Store review summaries and resumable downloads, Podcast widgets, Ambient Music, new system languages, and Matter robot-vacuum support arrived together.

changes.title: Image Playground Sketch and wider language support
changes.canonicalSummary: Image Playground gained a Sketch style while Apple Intelligence expanded to additional languages and English locales.
changes.summary: The release added Sketch as an Image Playground style and expanded Apple Intelligence support across eight more languages and two additional English locales.

changes.title: Mail categorization
changes.canonicalSummary: Mail on iPad automatically organized incoming messages into Primary, Transactions, Updates, and Promotions categories.
changes.summary: The iPad Mail app gained category tabs that grouped messages by broad purpose while preserving access to an all-mail view.

changes.title: Apple News+ Food and cooking mode
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple News+ added a recipe catalog, saved recipes, and a step-by-step cooking presentation.
changes.summary: News+ subscribers gained recipes from participating publishers, searchable and saved recipe collections, and a cooking mode for following individual steps.

changes.title: Photos library organization controls
changes.canonicalSummary: Photos gained more filters, sorting, collection-order controls, and privacy-aware import behavior.
changes.summary: The release added library filters, collection reordering, oldest-or-newest sorting, album sorting by modified date, controls for recent-history collections, and hidden-photo import protection.

changes.title: System, family, store, and Home additions
changes.canonicalSummary: A broad set of smaller additions covered emoji, Safari, child accounts, Screen Time, App Store, media widgets, languages, and Matter accessories.
changes.summary: Eight emoji, Safari recent searches, safer child setup, persistent app limits, App Store review summaries and resumable downloads, Podcast widgets, Ambient Music, new system languages, and Matter robot-vacuum support arrived together.

citations.locator: iPadOS 18.4 — additional enhancements and bug fixes

events.summary: The public iOS 18.4.1 release fixed a wireless CarPlay failure and two security vulnerabilities tied to sophisticated targeted attacks on iOS.

changes.title: Wireless CarPlay connection fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Wireless CarPlay reliability improved for a rare connection failure affecting certain vehicles.
changes.summary: The update addressed a rare condition that could prevent an iPhone from connecting to wireless CarPlay in certain vehicles.

changes.title: CoreAudio media code-execution fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Improved bounds checking addressed memory corruption and code execution from a malicious audio stream.
changes.summary: Apple fixed CoreAudio memory corruption triggered by malicious media and said the issue may have been exploited in an extremely sophisticated attack against specific targeted iOS users.

changes.title: Pointer Authentication bypass fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Removal of vulnerable code addressed a route for an attacker with memory access to bypass Pointer Authentication.
changes.summary: Apple corrected an RPAC issue that could let an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability bypass Pointer Authentication and linked it to the same class of targeted attacks.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.5 release added a Pride wallpaper, family visibility, purchase authorization, Vision Pro reliability, and expanded carrier satellite support.

changes.title: Pride Harmony wallpaper
changes.canonicalSummary: A Pride Harmony design joined the available Lock Screen wallpaper collection.
changes.summary: The update added Apple’s Pride Harmony wallpaper as a new Lock Screen appearance.

changes.title: Screen Time passcode-use notification
changes.canonicalSummary: Parents could be notified when the Screen Time passcode was used on a child’s device.
changes.summary: Family safety visibility increased by notifying a parent when someone entered the Screen Time passcode on a child’s iPhone.

changes.title: Buy with iPhone for Apple TV purchases
changes.canonicalSummary: An iPhone could authorize a content purchase initiated in the Apple TV app on a third-party device.
changes.summary: Buy with iPhone enabled purchase authorization on the iPhone when content was selected in the Apple TV app running on a supported third-party device.

changes.title: Apple Vision Pro app black-screen fix
changes.canonicalSummary: The Apple Vision Pro companion app no longer showed a black screen in the documented failure case.
changes.summary: Apple corrected an issue in which the Apple Vision Pro app could display a black screen.

changes.title: Carrier satellite support on iPhone 13
changes.canonicalSummary: Carrier-provided satellite services expanded to the iPhone 13 family where supported by a participating carrier.
changes.summary: All iPhone 13 models gained support for carrier-provided satellite features, subject to carrier and regional availability.

changes.summary: The update added Apple’s Pride Harmony wallpaper as a new appearance on iPad.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.6 release fixed Photos sharing, addressed accessibility privacy weaknesses, and retained a developer-documented HealthKit known issue.

changes.title: Photos memory-movie sharing fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Photos could once again share memory movies in the documented failure case.
changes.summary: Apple corrected an issue that could prevent a memory movie created in Photos from being shared.

changes.title: VoiceOver passcode-disclosure fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Improved accessibility checks prevented VoiceOver from speaking a device passcode through the documented path.
changes.summary: The security update fixed a logic issue through which VoiceOver could read a passcode aloud.

changes.title: Camera and microphone privacy-indicator fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Additional accessibility logic restored correct camera and microphone privacy-indicator behavior.
changes.summary: Apple addressed a condition in which the camera or microphone privacy indicator might not be displayed correctly.

changes.title: HealthKit data access at power-off screen
changes.canonicalSummary: On devices without a passcode, HealthKit data could become unavailable while the slide-to-power-off screen was displayed.
changes.summary: Apple’s developer notes warned that HealthKit data could become inaccessible at the slide-to-power-off screen on a device with no passcode, with adding a passcode or restarting listed as workarounds.

events.summary: The public iOS 18.7 release maintained the prior OS branch with unspecified bug fixes and a substantial security update; representative security changes are listed without claiming exhaustiveness.

changes.title: Unspecified maintenance fixes
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple reported important bug fixes for iOS 18.7 without publishing a component-level consumer fix list.
changes.summary: The consumer note said the update contained important bug fixes but did not identify affected features or symptoms, so this record retains only an aggregate entry.
changes.verificationMethod: Checked the complete iOS 18.7 section of Apple’s cumulative iOS 18 update article and separated its general bug-fix statement from the itemized security bulletin.

changes.title: Audio media memory-safety fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Improved bounds checking addressed malformed media that could terminate an app or corrupt process memory.
changes.summary: Apple corrected an out-of-bounds access in Audio that could let a maliciously crafted media file terminate an app unexpectedly or corrupt process memory.

changes.title: Locked Notes image-cache fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Improved cache handling prevented an unlocked-device attacker from viewing an image from the most recently opened locked note.
changes.summary: Apple fixed a Notes cache issue that could expose an image from the most recently viewed locked note to someone with physical access to an unlocked device.
